record.question: The main difference between 'New Service' and 'New Instrument of Service' as given in DFPR would be:
options: A New Service arises from a new policy decision involving a new activity or form of investment not previously brought to the notice of Parliament, whereas a New Instrument of Service involves substantial expenditure on an important expansion of an existing activity
A New Service is applicable only to Central Sector Schemes, whereas a New Instrument of Service is applicable only to Centrally Sponsored Schemes
A New Service relates to revenue expenditure, whereas a New Instrument of Service relates to capital expenditure
Large expenditures on transfers to State and Union Territories are always marked as New Service/New Instrument of Service
